project.title: Navisworks Export Plugins
project.tagline: Desktop plugins for Autodesk Navisworks Manage 2026 that export selected 3D geometry to GLB (PowerPoint 3D) and AutoCAD DWG formats
project.summary: Two Navisworks Manage 2026 plugins that solve a real BIM workflow gap: exporting only the user's current selection — never the whole model — to formats useful downstream. The GLB plugin enables interactive 3D presentations in PowerPoint, replacing static screenshots. The AutoCAD plugin lets designers continue working on selected geometry in AutoCAD.

problem.short: BIM coordinators working with large Navisworks models have no simple way to extract only a selected subset of objects into formats usable in presentations (PowerPoint 3D) or further CAD design (AutoCAD DWG).
pain_points: Interactive 3D in PowerPoint requires GLB — Navisworks has no native GLB export
Extracting geometry to AutoCAD for further work involves multi-step manual workarounds
Existing export options dump the entire model, not just the user's selection
Screenshots lose 3D interactivity; manual workarounds waste coordination time

plugins.name: Export to GLB
plugins.description: Exports the current Navisworks selection to a .glb file (glTF Binary) that can be inserted into PowerPoint as an interactive 3D model.
key_features: Exports only the current selection — never the whole model
Preserves per-object colors from Navisworks (including appearance overrides)
Automatic coordinate system conversion: Navisworks Z-up → glTF Y-up
Automatic unit conversion to meters (glTF standard)
PBR material setup tuned for PowerPoint 3D (metallic=0, roughness=0.8)
Compatible with PowerPoint 365 Insert 3D Model feature
Empty selection guard — shows user-friendly error instead of writing an empty file
Read-only — never modifies the source Navisworks model

plugins.name: Export to AutoCAD
plugins.description: Exports the current Navisworks selection to a .dwg file that opens directly in AutoCAD for further design work, with colored PolyfaceMesh entities and smooth curved surfaces.
key_features: Exports only the current selection — never the whole model
Geometry written as colored PolyfaceMesh entities (one per color per fragment)
Automatic unit conversion with correct INSUNITS header (supports mm, cm, m, ft, in, etc.)
Linear-to-sRGB color conversion so surfaces don't appear too dark in AutoCAD
Curved surface refinement (Phong tessellation) — elbows and pipe bends look smooth, not prismatic
Smart edge visibility: triangulation seams are hidden, real model edges stay visible
Vertex welding with epsilon tolerance for clean shading across shared edges
Winding-order correction so faces shade correctly under AutoCAD's flat lighting
Viewport defaults to Gouraud Shaded for immediate visual feedback
Detailed diagnostic logging to %TEMP% for troubleshooting
Read-only — never modifies the source Navisworks model

PrimitiveCallback — COM callback (public, ComVisible) that collects vertices/triangles
Vec3, Rgba, ExtractedTriangle, ExtractedFragment — geometry DTOs

projects.name: NavisworksExport.Glb.2026
projects.role: GLB export plugin for Navisworks Manage 2026
key_classes: GlbExportCommand — AddInPlugin entry point with assembly resolver, NoInlining guard
GlbWriter — Z-up→Y-up coordinate swap, PBR material setup, SharpGLTF scene building

projects.name: NavisworksExport.AutoCad.2026
projects.role: AutoCAD DWG export plugin for Navisworks Manage 2026
key_classes: AutoCadExportCommand — AddInPlugin entry point with assembly resolver, NoInlining guard
DwgWriter — PolyfaceMesh generation, vertex welding, edge visibility, sRGB conversion
CurvedSurfaceRefiner — Phong tessellation for smooth curved surfaces in flat-shaded DWG
PluginAssemblyResolver — runtime assembly probing from plugin folder

patterns: Assembly resolve pattern for private plugin dependencies
NoInlining separation: Execute() installs resolver → RunExport() does work (JIT safety)
Selection expansion: composite nodes → geometry-bearing leaves before extraction
Fragment-level geometry caching with COM object reference dedup
Phong tessellation subdivision for curved surface refinement

technical_challenges.solution: Implemented COM interop callback (InwSimplePrimitivesCB) with ComVisible attribute, proper COM state initialization, and path-identity filtering to handle fragment ownership across composite nodes
GLB requires Y-up right-handed (swapped from Navisworks Z-up), AutoCAD DWG stays Z-up. Unit conversion: GLB targets meters, DWG targets millimeters with INSUNITS header
Navisworks COM returns local-to-world transforms in column-major order — translation at indices 12/13/14, not 3/7/11. Separate transform paths for positions (full 4×4) and normals (3×3 rotation only)

technical_challenges.challenge: Flat shading artifacts in AutoCAD PolyfaceMesh
technical_challenges.solution: Built a Phong tessellation subdivider (CurvedSurfaceRefiner) that splits edges where endpoint normals diverge, lifting new vertices onto the tangent-plane interpolation of the surface. Multi-pass with triangle budget cap

Navisworks uses LoadFile-style loading that doesn't probe the plugin folder. Implemented AppDomain.AssemblyResolve handler and NoInlining method separation to prevent JIT crashes before the resolver is installed. Nested valuetype structs must use only primitive fields to survive the host's GetTypes scan

Navisworks reports colors in linear light. GLB/glTF defines COLOR_0 as linear (pass-through). DWG true colors are display values — implemented sRGB gamma transfer function. Per-vertex COM colors are unreliable on Manage 2026, so color is sourced from ModelItem.Geometry.ActiveColor with fallback chain

technical_challenges.challenge: Edge visibility in DWG wireframe mode
technical_challenges.solution: Computed face adjacency and normal angles to distinguish real model edges from triangulation seams. Only coplanar edges (< 1° threshold) are hidden, preserving barrel edges on pipes at ~15° facet angles

user_flow: User opens a large BIM model in Navisworks Manage 2026
User selects specific objects (pipes, structural elements, etc.)
User clicks 'Export to GLB' or 'Export to AutoCAD' from the Add-Ins ribbon
Plugin extracts geometry from selection via COM API
Plugin converts coordinates, colors, and writes the target format
User inserts GLB into PowerPoint as interactive 3D model, or opens DWG in AutoCAD
workflow.deployment: Post-build MSBuild target copies plugin DLLs into Navisworks Manage 2026 Plugins directory (elevated terminal required for Program Files access)

skills_demonstrated: Autodesk Navisworks API and COM interop programming
3D geometry processing (triangulation, coordinate transforms, normal computation)
glTF/GLB format and PBR material authoring
AutoCAD DWG format and entity modeling (PolyfaceMesh)
Computational geometry: Phong tessellation subdivision, vertex welding, edge classification
COM interop: callbacks, marshalling, ComVisible, assembly resolution
Plugin architecture for host applications with strict loading constraints
Color science: linear light ↔ sRGB gamma conversion
MSBuild custom targets and host-local API references
Solo end-to-end product development: problem → architecture → implementation
